# Nomzy Escapes

> Curated workation stays and immersive Kerala experiences for remote professionals — Fort Kochi, Varkala, and Alleppey.

Nomzy Escapes hand-picks homes with verified high-speed WiFi, dedicated workspaces, and on-the-ground local support so remote workers can stay productive while living slow in Kerala.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Nomzy Escapes workation experience across Kerala.
- [Properties](/properties): Browse all curated workation stays and homes.
- [Destinations](/destinations): Fort Kochi, Varkala, and Alleppey guides.
- [Experiences](/experiences): Surf, yoga, backwaters, food, and culture.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Nomzy Escapes team.
